thread:
emma: Quick thread to finalize blog + webinar wiring. Need headline options, CTA copy, HS mapping, and a legal sanity-check on the benchmark phrasing. Goal: publish tomorrow morning.
priya: Three fresh headline drafts: 
- 'Redwood Dedicated: predictable inference for production'
- 'Ship production LLMs with predictable latency and cost'
- 'Enterprise-grade inference, now easier to operate'
liam: I vote #1 but shorten it to 'Predictable inference for production' as the hero.
priya: Noted. Also drafting the hero subline: 'Reserved GPU capacity, predictable latency and clearer unit economics.'
jas: Need the hero claim to be legal-safe. @legal-bot, we'll avoid absolute numbers in hero.
legal-bot: Confirmed. Use ranges or qualifiers. If you include 'clearer unit economics' add link to methodology and an asterisk for the 40% stat.
maria: I'll ask design for a small badge that says 'Up to 40% typical token cost reduction*' with footnote link. Keep badge compact for mobile.
carlos: Routing checklist for HubSpot: map registration -> list 'launch_webinar_may2026', add property 'interested_in_benchmarks' as boolean, set source=blog_post, and queue logic: company_size>200 -> enterprise_sdr; else -> growth_sdr; overflow -> marketing-followup@redwood.
emma: Perfect. Can you paste the webhook-ready mapping so Eng can wire?
carlos: Pasted mapping for webhook: ```
event: form_submission
form_id: blog_launch_reg
actions:
  - set_list: launch_webinar_may2026
  - set_field: source = blog_post
  - set_field: interested_in_benchmarks = {{bench_checkbox}}
  - if company_size > 200 -> assign_to: enterprise_sdr
  - else -> assign_to: growth_sdr
  - fallback -> email: marketing-followup@redwood
```
priya: CTA text options: 
- 'Reserve demo + benchmark updates'
- 'Save my spot and send benchmarks'
- 'Register: demo + performance report'
liam: Prefer the middle one. Short + explicit.
jas: Webinar seating: 150 seats. Add a waitlist field and auto-email recording + benchmark PDF to waitlist. @maria handle the follow-up copy.
maria: Will create a follow-up sequence: immediate confirmation, 24h reminder, post-webinar recording + benchmarks to attendees + waitlist. Waitlist gets recording+benchmarks only.
legal-bot: For benchmark language, use 'up to 40% lower token cost on representative workloads' and link to 'benchmark methodology v3' in the appendix. Don't use 'always' or 'guaranteed'.
priya: Updated copy snippet: 'Predictable inference for production — reserved capacity, predictable latency, and up to 40% lower token cost on representative workloads (see methodology).' CTA: 'Save my spot and send benchmarks.'
liam: One minor thing: let's A/B test subject line for the lead nurture email: Variant A = 'Predictable inference for production', Variant B = 'Lower latency, lower cost: see Redwood Dedicated'.
emma: Add subject variants to the send flow. Also add campaign tag 'blog_launch_may2026'.
carlos: I'll add tags to HS mapping: campaign=blog_launch_may2026, source=blog_post. Webhook payload ready and I'll push to Eng channel when live.
jas: Timeline: final copy in doc by 10am PT tomorrow, HS routing live by EOD today, design badge mock by 4pm. Everyone OK?
priya: I'm on copy, will update by 9:30 and ping legal.
maria: Design pinged, will share badge concepts by 3pm.
carlos: Implementing HS mapping now, will report back when webhook is deployed.
legal-bot: I'll review once copy is in the doc; expect comments within 4 hours.
emma: Thanks all. Reply with :white_check_mark: when your item is done so I can close the loop.
